Message:
pinctrl: sh-pfc: r8a7794: Remove bogus SCIF0 SCK pin data

SCIF0 on R-Car E2 does not have an SCK pin.

"SCIF_CLK" is the (H)SCIF baud rate generation clock pin, which is not
yet supported.
